attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.recordHint: Original work dates and timezones are preserved. Punches cannot be edited, deleted or entered for another employee here.
attendance.activityHint: Totals count active employee/recorded-department pairs, not a full employee roster. No absence, lateness or working-hours judgment is made without schedules.
attendance.utcHint: Summary punch instants use UTC; recorded timezones explain historical punches. The absence-window timezone does not move recorded work dates.
attendance.truncated: Showing {shown} of {count} approved intervals; additional intervals are not expanded.
attendance.unavailable: Attendance is unavailable for the current identity or tenant package.
attendance.notAllowed: You do not have permission for this action.
attendance.loadFailed: Attendance could not be loaded. Retry.
attendance.retentionHint: Retention is 30–730 days; cleanup does not remove current-day records.
attendance.coordinateHint: Enter fixed office coordinates, up to six decimal places. These settings are not employee location tracks.
attendance.snapshotHint: These are the rule and office-location snapshots at punch time. Later configuration changes do not overwrite them.
